dedupeText: pop portrait album cover pop music portrait hand lettering pink accent shushing gesture soft focus 2000s aesthetic the pink script lettering frames the subject s forehead and hair the vertical finger gesture creates a central axis for the composition the high contrast lighting on the face draws immediate attention to the eyes and lips combine a high key shushing portrait with a dual typographic system expressive pink marker script on top and wide tracked white sans serif on bottom

recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up portrait of a young woman with dark hair, performing a 'shush' gesture with her finger to her lips, featuring large-scale pink script lettering overlaid at the top and clean sans-serif text at the bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: The pink script lettering frames the subject's forehead and hair.
The vertical finger gesture creates a central axis for the composition.
The high-contrast lighting on the face draws immediate attention to the eyes and lips.
coreInvariants: A single finger held vertically to the lips.
A vibrant bubblegum pink accent color for the main title.
Soft-focus, bright background to isolate the subject.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered close-up portrait, head and shoulders filling the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the vertical finger gesture.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the eyes, moves down the finger to the bottom text, then sweeps up to the pink script at the top.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal, primarily in the bright, blown-out background areas around the hair.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm skin tones and dark brunette hair (neutral base).
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant bubblegum pink for the script lettering and lipstick.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value in the background, high saturation in the pink accents, and deep shadows in the hair.

letterConstructionRules: Top text: Monolinear, fluid, hand-drawn script with large loops and long connectors.
Bottom text: Wide-tracked, all-caps geometric sans-serif with thin strokes.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The dot over the 'i' is replaced with a small hand-drawn heart shape.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme contrast between expressive, organic script and rigid, geometric sans-serif.

candidateDirections.reason: To match the fluid, personal feel of the top lettering.
To provide the clean, modern geometric base for the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-key portrait of a young woman with dark wavy hair, finger to lips in a shushing gesture, soft lighting, bright overexposed background, wearing a large cocktail ring.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, vibrant pink hand-written script across the top hair area, replacing the 'i' dot with a heart. Add a clean, white, wide-tracked geometric sans-serif title at the bottom.

verificationChecks: Is the pink script monolinear and fluid?
Is the bottom text all-caps with wide tracking?
Does the pink color match the lipstick tone?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the artist

mustAchieve: Balanced composition between top and bottom text

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the pink script doesn't obscure the eyes.
Check that the bottom text is perfectly centered.
Verify the heart icon is present over the 'i'.
Confirm the ring on the finger is visible and detailed.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-key shushing portrait with a dual-typographic system: expressive pink marker script on top and wide-tracked white sans-serif on bottom.
